name: cadence-clinical-workspace
description: > **The Metadata-Driven Clinical Execution Platform.** > *Unifying Clinical Study Design (MDR/SDR) and Electronic Data Capture (EDC) into a single, automated digital data flow.*

scripts.lint: pnpm -r lint && uv run ruff check .
scripts.format: pnpm -r format && uv run ruff format .
scripts.fix: uv run ruff check . --fix && uv run ruff format .
scripts.check: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail false -n "format,lint,secrets,adr,markdown,security,imports" -c "magenta,blue,yellow,cyan,gray,red,white" "pnpm format" "pnpm lint" "uv run pre-commit run detect-secrets --all-files" "python3 scripts/validate_adrs.py" "python3 scripts/validate_markdown.py" "uv run bandit -c pyproject.toml -ll -ii -r apps packages" "python3 scripts/validate_imports.py"
scripts.setup:dev: uv sync --python 3.11 --all-extras && uv run playwright install chromium && uv run pre-commit install --install-hooks
